title: Norm bound for degree truncation
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and let $q\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $2\le q$. The uniform $L^q$ norm of the degree-$k$ truncation of the Fourier expansion of $f$ is at most $(\sqrt{q-1})^k$ times the uniform $L^2$ norm of $f$.
